rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: The ANC's text headed 'Address of the President, Thabo Mbeki, at the opening of the 51st National Conference of the African National Congress', dated Stellenbosch, 16 December 2002, says 'We stand here today to present the Political Report dealing with the period since the 1997 50th National Conference', after recalling the report 'presented by our then President, Comrade Nelson Mandela' to that conference.

locator.section: Page title; heading and date line; paragraphs beginning 'Our 50th National Conference in Mafikeng' and 'We stand here today'
